summary: Example task creates a local access list named foo with pn_access_list on Netvisor.
questions: How do I create an access list on Pluribus Netvisor?

answer_card.title: Create a Netvisor access list
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Create access list
  community.network.pn_access_list:
    pn_name: "foo"
    pn_scope: "local"
    state: "present"
  register: acc_list
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.netvisor'
```
